QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Hold It Close
QuestInfo.0: You find clues that say the kidnapped citizen is being kept in the hold. Seeing as how only the starboard side is being guarded, that must be the hold. Time to investigate.
QuestInfo.1: You find clues that say the kidnapped citizen is being kept in the hold. Seeing as how only the starboard side is being guarded, that must be the hold. Time to investigate.
QuestInfo.2: Using the clues, you went to the hold. Thankfully, the citizen was safe. You let them know that the Traveler's Guild will come save them soon.
